page.overview:
Who is A'nang?

A'nang was a male Kwa who lived on Tython before the First Migration of the Tythans in the system. As the Kwa withdrew from Tython and the Galaxy at large in the face of Rakatan aggression, A'nang was one of the few who remained on Tython. He would be the last of these, and would construct a Holocron to pass on his knowledge, which was later found by the Je'daii Order and activated itself in 25,793 BBY, when a Je'daii Journeyer, Tasha Ryo, touched it.
